summary: A federal takeover and extended National Guard deployment in Washington, D.C. are prompting statehood advocates to argue that the city needs greater self-governance and autonomy. Meanwhile, D.C. secured a legal victory against the Trump administration regarding voter rolls, and questions about home rule authority continue to arise as federal control over local matters persists.

articles.title: One Year Later, DC Vote Says Federal Takeover Underscores the Urgency of DC Statehood
D.C. Wins Fight Against Trump Administration Over Voter Rolls
Trump’s National Guard Mission in Washington Carries a $1.4 Billion Price Tag as Deployment Extends Through 2029
One Year After President Trump Deployed National Guard Troops to Washington, D.C., Statehood is More Important Than Ever
